streamed_loop_arrays_status: hypothesis: the products stage omits the accumulate-line arrays of streamed_generator_product, 10 * prefix_rows * block_max bytes (contribution plus two uint32 temporaries per element); the figure fits 16 GiB only when the largest per-call prefix row count of the N = 19 receipt is at most max_prefix_rows_that_fit. fiber_rank_v14.py reports the term streamed_loop_arrays (10 * prefix_rows * block size) in preflight_terms once the receipt is loaded and refuses a run whose stage exceeds --max-gb; that preflight, or an instrumented run, settles it.
boundary: Upper bounds for the named dense arrays only; sparse tables, Python objects, the flint entry lists of each insertion, allocator state and file cache require an instrumented acceptance run.
